page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2i-c1m2.3xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon processor running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. This instance is provisioned with 12 dedicated virtual CPUs (vCPUs) and 24.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core. It operates on a KVM hypervisor and does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware.

The instance features a baseline network bandwidth of 8 Gbps. Because it lacks bundled local storage, all storage requirements must be met using external network-attached block storage. The 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio positions this instance as a compute-oriented resource, offering a cost-efficient profile for workloads that require dedicated processing power without the overhead of large memory allocations.

Given its hardware profile, the ecs.u2i-c1m2.3xlarge is suited for compute-intensive applications, web serving, batch processing, and lightweight application servers. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance, making it appropriate for environments where shared-core CPU stealing or burstable performance limits are undesirable.
